messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-49281 fired for service=inference-gateway, symptom=5xx_rate > 1.2% in prod-us-east1. trigger=error_rate_threshold

pagerduty: Auto-ack window 30s. Notifying on-call.

alex: saw it. getting into the runbook.

mia: joining — on my way, ping me with region details.

ryan: looks like a sudden spike in 502s from the auth-proxy -> gateway path, some logs attached in the alert.

jess: I can start a quick mitigation: disable noncritical routing rules and switch to fallback pool. want me to do it? :eyes:

alex: yes do it. mark as mitigation in PD.

jess: running `kubectl -n inference patch svc gateway --patch '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Cluster"}}'` to reduce small-network bounce.

ops-bot: Command executed: `kubectl patch` by jess at 1893456904. rollout status: in_progress

mia: I'm tailing the gateway logs: a lot of `upstream reset` and 502 from model-service-v2. Not seeing DB or KMS errors.

ryan: metric dump: 1m error rate peaked 3.8% at 1893456930, latency ~120ms p95.

alex: I'm updating the incident channel in PD to "investigating" and adding customers affected list.

pagerduty: Incident INC-49281 acknowledged by alex.

jess: I routed 10% of traffic to fallback model variant (v1-quant) via header-based rule. config id `route-evac-1893`.

ops-bot: Route change applied by jess at 1893456982. New traffic split: primary 90% / fallback 10%.

mia: after the split, error rate dropped to 1.1% within 45s. Still seeing 502s from a subset of hosts: gw-3a, gw-3b.

ryan: I'm SSHing into gw-3a, gathering `dmesg`, `docker ps`, and ps.

ryan: found a process repeatedly OOM-killing `model-proxy` on gw-3a, cgroup memory spikes. Kernel OOM logs align with spikes.

alex: interesting — could be a memory leak triggered by a new model shard. did we recently deploy something to model-service-v2?

mia: model-team deployed shard rollouts yesterday morning, but no config changes this hour. checking model logs.

jess: for immediate mitigation, I'm going to cordon gw-3a and gw-3b and drain them from load balancer. that'll remove the noisy hosts. ok?

alex: go ahead. escalate to oncall-sre if drain takes >2m or customers still impacted.

oncall-sre: I'm here, standing by to assist with host remediation. if cordon+drain doesn't help, we'll scale a replacement pool.

ops-bot: Nodes cordoned: gw-3a, gw-3b by jess at 1893457056. Draining connections...

mia: after drain, error rate down to 0.28% and p95 stable. routing shows traffic redistributed to gw-1/gw-2 and fallback pool.

ryan: OOM cause looks like an increase in KV cache growth after a specific request pattern. capturing heap profile for model-proxy and sending to model-dev.

alex: action items so far: (1) cordon+drain hosts (done), (2) route fallback 10% (done), (3) capture heap & logs (ryan), (4) open a follow-up for model-team to investigate leak.

jess: I'm leaving the fallback 10% in place for 30m and will monitor. if stable, we can revert to normal routing.

pagerduty: Incident INC-49281 status: mitigation in progress.

oncall-sre: notifying infra to repro on staging with same traffic pattern. raising a hotfix ticket for model-proxy memory handling.

mia: customer impact summary for PG: brief spike caused increased 502s for ~6 minutes concentrated in prod-us-east1. ~0.3% of overall requests experienced errors at peak. No data loss. IDS shows a handful of requests retried by clients.

alex: creating a customer-facing blurb for status.redwood: "We experienced elevated 502 errors in US-East for ~6 minutes due to transient gateway host instability; traffic redistributed and no customer data loss. Engineers are investigating root cause and will follow up."

jess: add note: we're rolling back recent model shard to stable in canary to validate hypothesis.

ryan: uploaded heap profile and logs to /s3/incidents/INC-49281/ and linked in PD.

ops-bot: Link: https://s3.internal.redwood/INC-49281/logs (internal)

alex: summarizing timeline for postmortem: 1893456789 alert fired -> 1893456904 patch -> 1893456982 route split -> 1893457056 nodes cordoned -> 1893457200 error rates normalized.

pagerduty: Incident INC-49281: assignees: alex (lead), jess (mitigation), ryan (host/debug), mia (scope/customer impact).

mia: handing off to next on-call in 30m for watch and follow-up. I'll create the follow-up ticket with next steps and assign to model-dev.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll keep PD updated and we can close when follow-ups are created. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: INC-49281 will remain in "mitigated" until follow-ups are confirmed.

jess: quick note for runbook: consider adding an automated temp-fallback step for gateway OOM patterns. filing a doc update.

oncall-sre: acknowledged. leaving channel but monitoring logs. ping for escalation.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived to INC-49281. End of thread.
